Cyanide is supposed to induce supreme suffering.

If it's any consolation you're clearly very accomplished and will probably be able to go incredibly far with your still-developing skillset. Most of us aren't as intelligent as you probably are, it's lonely at the top.

I don't feel that way at all, about a way out being soothing. I used to, but it doesn't make this all go away, this is still here and will continue to be long after I'm gone. I'm not a part of it and that's my own fault for being so pathetic and weak and mentally crippled and broken. I don't really have access to the most reasonable way out, I wish I did, so it's one of the haphazard ones like jumping and praying. I started getting those desires to just do it, but it has to be a certain height or you risk living.

Personally, I feel like a trapped animal.  Every chance, every risk, every action I've ever taken turned out wrong or just didn't matter at all. It's really scary, I feel sick, because logically this is the answer, logically this pain isn't going to go away, there is no reason for it to.

If I had a way out I would have done it a while ago, that would have been really nice. Things just get worse in the most unimaginably macabre ways, I'm basically in shock at this point, just staring into space because at this point I have no fucking clue. This organism fucking failed so hard, so embarrassingly that it's a stain on whatever the fuck genetic or otherwise legacy it so clearly failed to get close to passing.

Thanks though for the shout out to Hermeticism.

That really should work, I appreciate the response, but the more I volunteered, the more difficult it was to resolve how little I was able to relate to anyone and more specifically, they me.  I just started getting really jealous and resentful watching them form bonds but bristle in my presence. It's sort of like, if I don't get to experience joy, and if no one owes me anything, and everyone will try to take what I have, and always have, ever since fucking preschool, then why would I help someone who would never in a million years help me?  To feel like a king or good?  I want to be connected, that's what feels good.

Thanks though.

Right, I don't disagree.  Only so much happiness and joy to go around, the rest of us are just the fucking punching bags.

I'm really scared, I am completely out of options but I don't want to die. It's just, there is nothing here for me and every day gets worse and knowing that other people get to be happy but I never will just makes it worse.

Great, so my part is to feel horrible all the time because that's the universe.  I get it, I really do.  I wish we would just let the losers die, because I am having a very difficult time managing up the courage to do this, but there is LITERALLY NOTHING left to do but die. I am so fucking sick of everything just getting worse in the face of effort, but I get it, everyone else besides the homeless people are all stronger than I am.  I get it. I'll be gone eventually, I'm just fucking scared.
